Exploring the New Subject Rankings

The Guardian University Guide 2027 has officially launched its comprehensive suite of subject tables, offering prospective students a detailed look at individual academic disciplines across UK universities. Alongside the overall university rankings, the newly published data provides specific league tables and descriptive profiles for a wide spectrum of fields, ranging from traditional disciplines like history and mathematics to specialized modern pathways such as animation and game design.

Designed to help prospective undergraduates navigate their higher education options, the release breaks down individual areas of study. Each featured subject entry contains a dedicated league table alongside informational profiles detailing what the respective course of study involves.

Breadth of Academic Disciplines Covered

The published directory encompasses dozens of distinct fields, ensuring coverage across traditional sciences, humanities, engineering, and creative arts. Featured academic areas include:

  • Sciences and Medicine: Biology, Chemistry, Physics, Computer Science, Anatomy and Physiology, Medicine, Nursing (General, Children's, and Mental Health), Pharmacy and Pharmacology, and Veterinary Science.
  • Humanities and Social Sciences: History, English, Philosophy, Politics, International Relations, Sociology and Social Policy, Criminology, and Theology and Religious Studies.
  • Engineering and Technical Fields: Aerospace Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Electrical and Electronic Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, and General Engineering.
  • Creative and Applied Arts: Architecture, Fine Art, Fashion and Textiles, Graphic Design, Film Production and Photography, Drama and Dance, and Creative Writing.

Practical Implications and Reader Verification

For students currently researching higher education choices for upcoming entry cycles, these subject tables serve as a directional tool to compare institutional performance within specific academic niches rather than relying solely on overall university standings.

What Is Confirmed vs. Unknown

  • Confirmed: The Guardian University Guide 2027 provides specific league tables and subject profiles for dozens of academic areas taught at UK institutions.
  • Unknown: The specific methodology score shifts, exact rank changes for individual institutions within each sub-table, and long-term career outcome statistics are detailed directly within the source publication rather than the summary index.

Readers can verify these listings, examine individual institutional rankings, and read detailed course descriptions by visiting the official [Guardian University Guide 2027 Subject Tables](https://www.theguardian.com/education/2026/sep/12/guardian-university-guide-2027-find-your-subject).
